tasks.behavior: Confirm it's you works: Forwend emails its own code and a confirmed session stays fresh for 15 minutes
acceptance: POST /v1/me/fresh-sign-in emails a 6-digit code from the api, at most one per 30 s and 10 per hour; the code is hashed, lasts 10 minutes and allows 5 tries (D-49)
POST /v1/me/fresh-sign-in/verify with the right code makes the token's Privy session pass FreshSignIn for 15 minutes; a wrong, expired or other session's code doesn't (R-137)
The web's Confirm it's you sends and checks Forwend's code in place, then repeats the request (R-137)
A live run confirms in place after the session went stale and the send goes through (R-137)
notes: 2026-11-06 review pass by reviewer: Pass. Read show F428 and git diff 46e23458..HEAD. Security: 6-digit code from crypto/rand, stored as sha256(row id:code), compared with subtle.ConstantTimeCompare; 5 tries and 10 minutes per code, newest code per session only, locked FOR UPDATE so tries count under concurrency; lookups filter on both user and sid, so another user or session can't use it; Fresh counts only confirmed_at within auth.FreshWindow. Send reads the Privy login email before taking the user row lock, checks 30 s per session and the hourly cap per user under that lock, commits, then emails outside the lock; a failed email deletes the row so it counts toward neither limit. Keys and missing tokens get 401 on both routes (RequireUser). Errors map to wrong_code 422, code_sent_recently and too_many_codes 429 with Retry-After, no_login_email 409, code_unavailable 503; no code or secret reaches a log or error string. Web: code_sent_recently counts as sent, no_login_email hides the code box, other failures offer a resend; verify failures say wrong or expired. Tests would fail if session binding, tries, expiry, window, lock or failed-email cleanup broke. Docs, openapi and .env.example match the code. Ran: go test ./internal/reauth/... ./internal/httpapi/tests/ ./internal/notify/ ./internal/config/ -count=1 (ok); vitest run src/features/auth (9 passed); harness check typecheck lint docs-check (passed). Non-blocking: too_many_codes shows the generic could-not-send line, and its Send a code button will get 429 again until Retry-After; fresh_sign_ins rows are never pruned; accept 4's live test stops at Review after the guarded prepare passes, the full send is covered by the other send.spec tests; an unknown users row in Send gives 500, not 404.

proof.1: unit: TestAConfirmedCodeMakesItsSessionFresh (one code per session per 30 s, code_sent_recently), TestCodesAreLimitedPerUser (five requests at once send one email; the eleventh in an hour is too_many_codes with Retry-After near an hour), TestACodeWhoseEmailFailedIsNotSent, TestCodesNeedASignedInPersonWithAnEmail (no_login_email 409; a key or no token 401), TestACodeEndsAfterFiveTriesOrTenMinutes; notify test: the email carries the code and says it works for 10 minutes
proof.2: unit: TestAConfirmedCodeMakesItsSessionFresh: a stale session gets reauth_required, a wrong code and another session's code get 422, the right code 204 makes that session pass FreshSignIn and not another, a used code fails, and 16 minutes later it no longer counts; TestProtectedChangesNeedAFreshSignIn still passes
proof.3: web-unit: fresh-sign-in.test.tsx sends the code, a full code confirms in place, a wrong code says so, a new code on request, code_sent_recently counts as sent but too_many_codes doesn't, and no_login_email hides the code box; live-e2e: the keys confirm test sends, refuses a wrong code and confirms the emailed one
